description: Canonical ERN Part 52 market data for trajectory replication

source.note: Column K formula selects FFR (column M) when available, otherwise Short-term Yield (column N)

extraction.method: openpyxl data_only=True read of each cell
transformations: None - raw cell values extracted directly

provenance_notes: CPI is Shiller CPI, monthly, not seasonally adjusted
SPX-TR is S&P 500 Total Return Index (dividend-reinvested, nominal)
FFR/3M spliced rate is annual decimal (e.g., 0.0410 = 4.10%)
Before 1954-07, FFR column is empty; Short-term Yield used as fallback
